{{Quote|When our ancestors were still howling primates, our galaxy was ruled by a species that could create, reconfigure or destroy star systems according to some unimaginable whim.|Dr. Insmot Bowen|<ref name="cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>}}
[[File:UnidentifiedBalnabCreature.jpg|thumb|250px|The hesten were a species of primates.]]
'''Primates''',<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> also known as '''simians''',<ref name="Lando">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', Chapter 9.</ref> were an order of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that exhibited the characteristics of [[Ape/Legends|apes]] or [[Monkey/Legends|monkeys]], such as [[Hair/Legends|fur]], fingers, and opposable thumbs. Because of their similarity to [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="NEGAS" /> which were primates themselves,<ref name="cut" /> those [[Species/Legends|species]] were often referred to as [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]], though it depended on their [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] designation. Most primates gave birth to a single live young at a time, although multiple births were not unheard of in Humans.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Examples of [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] primates included the [[Hesten/Legends|hesten]], [[Momong/Legends|momongs]],<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Taurill/Legends|Taurill]],<ref name="EC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']], part VII {{C|Under ''The Darksaber Threat''}}</ref> and [[nightmare demon]]s.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|90|Reist}}</ref> The [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], which were [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammalian]] creatures, were also linked to primates.<ref name="NEGAS" />

[[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were considered to be a simian [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] species had several insults to use against simians.<ref name="Lando" />
